about_company.about_short: Makes flexible metal flow systems and is expanding into liquid-cooling assemblies for AI data centres.
about_company.business_intro: Aeroflex makes stainless-steel flexible hoses, assemblies, fittings, bellows and liquid-cooling skid assemblies. Customers use them to control liquids and gases in industrial and mission-critical systems; revenue comes from selling engineered components and customised assemblies in India and export markets.
about_company.about_long: Aeroflex's core products are corrugated stainless-steel hoses and value-added assemblies used in oil and gas, chemicals, steel, HVAC, railways and other industries. It has added fittings through Hyd-Air, metal bellows and Secondary Fluid Network skid assemblies used in data-centre liquid cooling. The company manufactures near Mumbai and Pune, sells in more than 90 countries and develops products in-house for specialised applications.

company_timeline.title: Acquired by Aeroflex Enterprises
company_timeline.detail: Aeroflex Enterprises was formerly named Sat Industries.

company_timeline.title: Acquires Hyd-Air Engineering
company_timeline.detail: The acquisition added hydraulic fittings and fluid connectors to the product range.

company_timeline.title: Signs liquid-cooling supply agreement; first skids shipped
company_timeline.detail: Long-term agreement with a US-listed corporation and a first ₹7.8 crore order, disclosed on the Q1 FY26 call; the first 46 skids shipped in Q3 FY26.

company_timeline.title: Expands capacity to 20 Mn m of hose and 12,000 skids
company_timeline.detail: Completed in Q2 FY27. Skid capacity is due to reach 15,000 by December 2026, and a ₹202 crore programme targets 30 million metres of hose and 30,000 skids by March 2028.

business_facts.text: In Q2 FY27 the deck's product chart put stainless-steel flexible hoses at 34% of revenue, assemblies and other products (fittings, metal bellows) at 41% and SFN skid assemblies at 25%, against 48% hoses and 52% assemblies a year earlier. The chart's shares match standalone revenue; on consolidated revenue from operations, which also counts Hyd-Air's fittings, hoses were about 33%, assemblies and others about 43% and skids 24.1%. In FY26 hoses were 43% and assemblies and others 52% of consolidated revenue.
business_facts.title: Product mix

business_facts.text: Exports were 60% of Q2 FY27 revenue and domestic sales 40%, against 74% and 26% a year earlier. Within exports, the Americas were 66%, Europe 25% and other markets 9%. The shares come from the deck's chart, which matches standalone revenue. The company reports a presence in more than 90 countries.
business_facts.title: Export reach

business_facts.text: Management said its biggest international customer contributed about 25–26% of sales (Q4 FY26 call). Skid assemblies go to a single customer, the Indian subsidiary of a US-listed company, under a five-year exclusivity agreement that covers India only; in Q2 FY27 skid sales to that customer were ₹50.03 crore, 24.1% of consolidated revenue from operations.
business_facts.title: Customer concentration

business_facts.text: Aeroflex reports four manufacturing plants near the JNPT port; its map names Taloja in Navi Mumbai, Lodha-Palava in Thane and Chakan in Pune, where its subsidiary Hyd-Air is based. A ₹202 crore programme due by March 2028 is set to add hose and skid capacity.
business_facts.title: Manufacturing footprint

business_facts.text: Installed capacity at Q2 FY27 was 20 million metres of hose, 12,000 skid assemblies, 46 assembly stations with 2 robotic welding lines and 1,20,000 metal bellows a year. Skid capacity is due to reach 15,000 by December 2026, and a ₹202 crore programme targets 30 million metres of hose and 30,000 skids by March 2028; those are plans, not operating capacity. Hose capacity ran at about 70% utilisation in FY26.
business_facts.title: Capacity & utilisation

business_facts.text: The company reports 29 qualified R&D professionals and a NABL-accredited laboratory, and has worked with IIT Bombay, IIT Indore, IIT Guwahati and IIT Ropar to develop new products. Its October 2026 investor presentation reports a newly granted Indian patent for automatically generating 3D CAD models of braided hose assemblies.
business_facts.title: R&D team and patent

business_facts.text: Skid assemblies are made to the cooling-system design for each data-centre floor, so unit values vary with configuration. The company says a skid typically sells for ₹1.1 lakh to ₹5.5 lakh depending on specifications; the Q2 FY27 average was about ₹3.39 lakh (1,475 skids for ₹50.03 crore). This is a mix average, not a price series.
business_facts.title: Custom engineering
Hyd-Air to merge into Aeroflex (proposed)
business_facts.text: Aeroflex has announced a proposed merger of Hyd-Air Engineering, the wholly owned subsidiary it acquired in April 2024, into the company, subject to necessary approvals. The company says the merger should eliminate operational overlaps, simplify the corporate structure and reduce administrative and compliance-related costs.

what_changed.headline: Liquid cooling has become a material revenue line.
what_changed.text: SFN skid assemblies brought in ₹50.03 crore in Q2 FY27, 24.1% of consolidated revenue from operations. As that business scaled, domestic sales rose to 40% of revenue from 26% a year earlier and exports were 60%; those two shares come from the deck's chart, which matches standalone revenue.
